subject: Invoice hold: retro-assigned usage to different legal entity -> EU VAT reclassification
messages:
From: Elena Novak <enovak@mercatushealth.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: payments+billing@mercatushealth.com
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Invoice hold - May invoice shows charges on EU entity we don't recognize

Hi Priya,

We've placed the May invoice on hold (ref attached) — it shows a large token credit applied to Mercatus EU Ltd (our EU legal entity) for a retroactive ingest reprocess on 2026-05-04. Our systems indicate that batch should have been attributed to Mercatus Global Inc (non-EU).

This matters because the VAT treatment is different and our AP team cannot pay the EU-rostered invoice while the entity mapping is unclear. Please could you: 1) confirm which internal entity the tokens were attributed to in your ledger, 2) provide the usage export for 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-05 with request ids, and 3) indicate whether this was caused by a rewrite/backfill on Redwood's side or a Mercatus retry we can reconcile?

I've attached a CSV pull from our side (mercatus_entity_map.xlsx) showing how we tag customer namespaces to entities. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — AP is asking for an answer by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Elena Novak
Head of Finance Operations
Mercatus Health

Attachments: mercatus_entity_map.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Novak <enovak@mercatushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-18T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice hold - May invoice shows charges on EU entity we don't recognize

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the spreadsheet. We see the hold on your account. I'm looping in Ben (accounts lead) and Evelyn (finance) to validate ledger attribution and tax impact.

First-pass findings from our telemetry: on 2026-05-04 at 02:12 UTC there was a queued backfill job that reprocessed a nightly ingest window. The runtime assigned tokens to the request namespace "mercatus_search" which historically maps to the Global account, but we have a recent override rule in our routing table that maps the same namespace to Mercatus EU Ltd for customers with EU tenancy. I'm attaching an export of the raw usage lines that includes request ids.

We will: 1) confirm whether the override was active for Mercatus on the processing date, 2) extract the token rows and correlated request ids, and 3) provide an itemized CSV for audit. Expect an update within 24 hours.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_export_20260518.csv (CSV, 78KB)

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-19T08:21:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Invoice hold - data and quick outcome recommendation

Folks — I reviewed the exported rows. Summary for quick consumption:
- Retro-process job id: RB-9812 triggered 2026-05-04T02:12:09Z; it re-ingested ~1.2M tokens.
- Routing override was active for mercatus_search between 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-10; that maps to Mercatus EU Ltd.
- The override was intentionally set for EU-region customers during a short A/B sandbox but we failed to scope it by tenant id; this caused the namespace to flip for Global customers who had cross-region tenants.

Recommendation: offer a pro-rated credit corresponding to tokens attributed to the EU entity and reissue an adjusted invoice with VAT reversed if Mercatus confirms those rows should be Global. Operationally we should also: remove the override, add tenant-scoped guards, and run a one-off attribution correction for affected days.

Evelyn — can you provide a quick estimate of credit amount if we reverse the EU VAT and reattribute ~1.2M tokens to non-EU pricing?

Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-19T11:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice hold - data and quick outcome recommendation

Ben/Priya — ran the numbers. If we reattribute the 1.2M tokens from EU entity to Global:
- Gross token value (list price): €9,600
- EU VAT included on current invoice: €1,920 (20% assumed)
- Adjusted charge (non-EU): €9,600 without VAT -> net reduction on tax lines is €1,920; depending on contract we may owe a small currency conversion/service fee but I'd cap the customer credit at €1,920 plus a goodwill credit of €200 for AP operational cost.

I propose: issue credit memo for €2,120, regenerate invoice without EU VAT, and mark the case for manual hold release. Legal/public tax consult not required unless Mercatus insists on reverse-charge evidence.

I'll draft the credit memo and copy to accounting for execution once Priya confirms customer mapping.

—Evelyn
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Novak <enovak@mercatushealth.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: payments+billing@mercatushealth.com
Date: 2026-05-20T07:49:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice hold - May invoice shows charges on EU entity we don't recognize

Thanks for the fast investigation. We've reviewed the request ids you sent and confirmed: the ingest requests were initiated by Mercatus Global Inc (tenant id 03-GLB) during a retry from our side after a failed upload on 2026-05-03. The namespace mercatus_search is shared across tenants; our tagging is per-tenant.

We agree the override should not have applied. Please proceed with the reattribution and credit memo you outlined. AP will release the hold once we receive the corrected invoice and the credit memo; target is by EOD Friday.

Also please include a short note in the credit memo referencing Doc ID RB-9812 so our auditors can trace the correction.

Best,
Elena

From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Novak <enovak@mercatushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-22T17:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice hold - May invoice shows charges on EU entity we don't recognize

Elena — thanks for confirming the tenant id and for the path forward. We're issuing a credit memo for €2,120 (ref CM-20260522-RB9812) and regenerating the May invoice without EU VAT; both documents will be sent to payments+billing@mercatushealth.com and copied to the HubSpot deal.

Operational follow-ups: 1) I requested an emergency config rollback to remove the tenant-agnostic override (done), 2) Engineering will backfill a tenant-scoped attribution correction for 2026-04-29 -> 2026-05-10 (ETA 48 hours), and 3) I'll send a short post-mortem to Elena and Mercatus AP with the change log and request ids once complete.

If you need the DocuSign/trace evidence included in the credit memo, let me know — otherwise we'll close the hold once AP acknowledges receipt.

— Priya
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments sent with credit memo: redwood_invoice_202605.pdf (PDF, 120KB), CM-20260522-RB9812.pdf (credit memo, 18KB)
